topics.title: A candle's opening timestamp is not proof its completed high and low were available
topics.specificReviewFocus: A five-minute opening label can be mistaken for the time the complete values were known.
topics.actionNeeded: Record true data availability and source timing and ensure no future observations are visible to a prior decision.

topics.title: A forming candle's final high is unknown until the candle finishes
topics.specificReviewFocus: A partial-bar high may be valid so far but must not be described as the eventual final high.
topics.actionNeeded: Record true data availability and source timing and ensure no future observations are visible to a prior decision.

topics.title: Earlier completed context can warm indicators without revealing later replay decisions
topics.specificReviewFocus: Historical context is not the same as a permission to browse the entire outcome on a future bar.
topics.actionNeeded: Record true data availability and source timing and ensure no future observations are visible to a prior decision.

topics.title: Indicator warmup must use completed past observations and declared seed rules
topics.specificReviewFocus: Platform-specific warmup and seed conventions may differ, and warmup output is not a trade recommendation.
topics.actionNeeded: Record true data availability and source timing and ensure no future observations are visible to a prior decision.

topics.title: EMA 9 and EMA 20 can disagree at startup because of seeding, not a changed market
topics.specificReviewFocus: An EMA recursion cannot establish a correct first EMA without a documented seed and preceding history.
topics.actionNeeded: Record true data availability and source timing and ensure no future observations are visible to a prior decision.

topics.title: An absent data bar is not a zero-priced candle
topics.specificReviewFocus: A missing row and a genuine zero-volume interval are different states; filling OHLC with zero corrupts indicator calculations.
topics.actionNeeded: Record true data availability and source timing and ensure no future observations are visible to a prior decision.

topics.title: Unknown volume must never be silently treated as observed zero volume
topics.specificReviewFocus: Zero is a measurement; null means not available, and denominators may then be invalid.
topics.actionNeeded: Record true data availability and source timing and ensure no future observations are visible to a prior decision.

topics.title: Split-adjusted prices and unadjusted execution prices answer different questions

topics.actionNeeded: Record true data availability and source timing and ensure no future observations are visible to a prior decision.

topics.title: Exchange session time and a learner's local clock must be separated

topics.title: Changing the chart viewport does not change an indicator's historical calculation

topics.title: A higher-timeframe bar must not reveal its final value before the interval ends

topics.title: A replay decision must preserve its own time-stamped evidence envelope

topics.title: A current revised economic number is not necessarily what traders knew on its observation date

topics.title: A financial statement's period end is not its EDGAR public filing timestamp

topics.title: A corporate-event announcement and effective date are not interchangeable

topics.title: Retrospective exit quality metrics must not leak into the original decision

indicators.title: Simple Moving Average
indicators.formula: SMA(N,t) = SUM(Close[k] for k=t-N+1...t) / N, using N completed valid closing prices; price units.

indicators.title: Exponential Moving Average
indicators.formula: EMA(t)=alpha*P(t)+(1-alpha)*EMA(t-1); alpha=2/(N+1)

indicators.title: Weighted Moving Average
indicators.formula: WMA=sum(weight_i*price_i)/sum(weight_i)

indicators.title: Hull Moving Average
indicators.formula: HMA=WMA(2*WMA(P,N/2)-WMA(P,N),sqrt(N)); rounding varies

indicators.title: Double Exponential Moving Average
indicators.formula: DEMA=2*EMA(P,N)-EMA(EMA(P,N),N)

indicators.title: Triple Exponential Moving Average
indicators.formula: EMA1=EMA(Close,N), EMA2=EMA(EMA1,N), EMA3=EMA(EMA2,N); TEMA=3*EMA1-3*EMA2+EMA3, all properly seeded.

indicators.title: Kaufman Adaptive Moving Average
indicators.formula: Efficiency ratio compares net change with sum of absolute intermediate changes

indicators.title: Moving Average Ribbon
indicators.formula: Overlay several declared SMA or EMA periods on the same price source

indicators.title: Moving Average Convergence Divergence
indicators.formula: MACD=EMA_fast-EMA_slow; signal=EMA(MACD)

indicators.title: MACD Histogram
indicators.formula: MACD histogram(t) = EMA12(Close)(t) - EMA26(Close)(t) - EMA9(MACD line)(t); report only after signal warm-up.

indicators.title: Percentage Price Oscillator
indicators.formula: PPO=100*(EMA_fast-EMA_slow)/EMA_slow

indicators.title: Relative Strength Index
indicators.formula: RSI=100-100/(1+RS); RS=avg_gain/avg_loss using declared smoothing

indicators.title: Stochastic Oscillator
indicators.formula: %K=100*(close-lowest_low)/(highest_high-lowest_low)

indicators.title: Stochastic RSI
indicators.formula: StochRSI=(RSI-min(RSI,N))/(max(RSI,N)-min(RSI,N))

indicators.title: Commodity Channel Index
indicators.formula: CCI=(typical_price-SMA(typical_price))/(0.015*mean_deviation)

indicators.title: Williams Percent R
indicators.formula: %R=-100*(highest_high-close)/(highest_high-lowest_low)

indicators.title: Rate of Change
indicators.formula: ROC(N,t) = 100 * (Close[t] / Close[t-N] - 1) percent, provided Close[t-N] is nonzero and both closes are completed.

indicators.title: Price Momentum
indicators.formula: Price momentum(N,t) = Close[t] - Close[t-N] in price units, using two completed observations at the declared lookback.

indicators.title: TRIX
indicators.formula: TRIX=ROC(one-bar, triple EMA of price)

indicators.title: Know Sure Thing
indicators.formula: Weighted sum of moving averages of four ROC series

indicators.title: Aroon Up and Down
indicators.formula: AroonUp=100*(N-bars_since_high)/N; Down analog

indicators.title: Aroon Oscillator
indicators.formula: Aroon oscillator=AroonUp-AroonDown

indicators.title: Average Directional Index
indicators.formula: Wilder smoothing of DX based on +DI and -DI

indicators.title: Positive and Negative Directional Indicators
indicators.formula: +DI and -DI normalize smoothed directional movement by true range

indicators.title: Parabolic Stop and Reverse
indicators.formula: Rising SAR candidate = prior SAR + prior AF × (prior extreme high − prior SAR); clamp to the smaller of the two preceding lows, with trend-reversal handling and AF update defined by implementation.

indicators.title: Ichimoku Cloud
indicators.formula: Tenkan=(highest high of 9 completed bars + lowest low of 9)/2; Kijun uses 26; Senkou A=(Tenkan+Kijun)/2 plotted 26 bars forward; Senkou B uses 52-bar midpoint plotted 26 bars forward.

indicators.title: Supertrend
indicators.formula: Illustrative raw basic bands = (completed high+low)/2 ± multiplier×seeded ATR; final carried bands, reversals and initial direction require an explicitly selected platform algorithm.

indicators.title: Bollinger Bands
indicators.formula: Middle = SMA(N) of completed closes; population SD = sqrt(sum((close−SMA)^2)/N) for the explicitly chosen variant; upper/lower = SMA ± k×SD (platform SD convention must be declared).

indicators.title: Bollinger Percent B
indicators.formula: %B = (completed price − lower Bollinger Band)/(upper Bollinger Band − lower Bollinger Band), undefined for coincident bands.

indicators.title: Bollinger BandWidth
indicators.formula: BandWidth_percent = 100×(upper Bollinger Band−lower Bollinger Band)/middle SMA, provided middle is nonzero; distinguish raw ratio from percent display.

indicators.title: Keltner Channels
indicators.formula: Modern illustrative Keltner upper/lower = seeded EMA(N) of completed price ± k×seeded ATR(M), with EMA/ATR lengths and alternative historic channel definitions explicit.

indicators.title: Donchian Price Channels
indicators.formula: Upper channel = maximum of N eligible completed highs; lower = minimum of N eligible completed lows. Explicitly distinguish current-bar-inclusive displays from prior-N-bar breakout comparisons.

indicators.title: Average True Range
indicators.formula: TR(t)=max(high−low, abs(high−prior close), abs(low−prior close)); example seed ATR(N)=mean of first N valid TR values; Wilder update ATR_t=((N−1)×ATR_(t−1)+TR_t)/N.

indicators.title: Average True Range Percent
indicators.formula: ATRP_percent=100×seeded ATR(N) in price units / eligible completed close in price units; undefined at a zero or invalid close.

indicators.title: Historical Volatility
indicators.formula: For N completed logarithmic returns r_i=ln(C_i/C_(i−1)), sample SD=sqrt(sum((r_i−mean r)^2)/(N−1)); annualized historical volatility=sample SD×sqrt(defined return intervals per year), valid N≥2.

indicators.title: Chandelier Exit
indicators.formula: Chandelier long reference = highest eligible high(N) − k×seeded ATR(N); short reference = lowest eligible low(N) + k×seeded ATR(N); settings, lookback and execution assumption declared.

indicators.title: Pivot Points
indicators.formula: Classic PP=(Hprev+Lprev+Cprev)/3; R1=2*PP-Lprev; S1=2*PP-Hprev; use one completely finished prior session.

indicators.title: Fibonacci Retracement
indicators.formula: Upward swing retracement level=H−r×(H−L), where L and H are fixed, already observed swing endpoints, 0<=r<=1; reverse direction for a down-swing bounce.

indicators.title: Volume Weighted Average Price
indicators.formula: Exact transaction VWAP=Σ(trade_price_i×trade_shares_i)/Σ(trade_shares_i); OHLCV HLC3 proxy=Σ(((H+L+C)/3)×bar_volume)/Σ(bar_volume); reset/feed and denominator must be declared.

indicators.title: Anchored VWAP
indicators.formula: Anchored print VWAP(t;a)=Σ_{i=a..t}(trade_price_i×volume_i)/Σ_{i=a..t}volume_i; if using bar typical prices, explicitly label a bar proxy; anchor a fixed before evaluating later bars.

indicators.title: VWAP Deviation Bands
indicators.formula: Illustrative bands=VWAP±k×σ, where σ is an explicitly defined dispersion of eligible price deviations and k is a declared multiplier; exact vendor deviations/weights may differ.

indicators.title: Average Volume
indicators.formula: Volume SMA(N,t)=Σ_{j=t−N+1..t}V_j/N shares per completed comparable bar; N positive and N history bars required.

indicators.title: Relative Volume
indicators.formula: Completed-bar RVOL(t)=current_completed_bar_volume / SMA(prior N comparable completed-bar volumes); exclude current bar from baseline and reject zero baseline.

indicators.title: Matched-Time Relative Volume
indicators.formula: Cumulative matched-time RVOL at clock t=volume_since_open_today_through_t / mean(volume_since_open_previous_day_through_same_clock_t) over N comparable prior sessions.

indicators.title: Dollar Volume
indicators.formula: Exact traded notional over declared feed/window=Σ_i(trade_price_i in USD × trade_shares_i) USD; bar close×volume is only a disclosed price proxy.

indicators.title: On Balance Volume
indicators.formula: OBV_t=OBV_(t−1)+V_t if C_t>C_(t−1); −V_t if lower; unchanged if equal; initial seed arbitrary and must be declared.

indicators.title: Accumulation Distribution Line
indicators.formula: CLV=(2C−H−L)/(H−L) for H>L; MoneyFlowVolume=CLV×V; ADL_t=ADL_(t−1)+MoneyFlowVolume; declare H=L handling.

indicators.title: Chaikin Money Flow
indicators.formula: CMF(N,t)=Σ_{last N completed bars}(CLV_i×V_i)/Σ_{last N completed bars}V_i, CLV=(2C−H−L)/(H−L); declare zero-range convention and nonzero aggregate volume.

indicators.title: Money Flow Index
indicators.formula: MFI=100-100/(1+positive_money_flow/negative_money_flow)

indicators.title: Chaikin Oscillator
indicators.formula: ChaikinOsc=EMA_fast(ADL)-EMA_slow(ADL)

indicators.title: Percentage Volume Oscillator
indicators.formula: PVO=100*(EMA_fast(volume)-EMA_slow(volume))/EMA_slow(volume)

indicators.title: Force Index
indicators.formula: ForceIndex=(close-prior_close)*volume

indicators.title: Volume by Price or Volume Profile
indicators.formula: Sum volume into chosen price intervals; allocation method depends on feed

indicators.title: Price Relative Strength versus Benchmark
indicators.formula: Ratio=adjusted_security_price/adjusted_benchmark_price

indicators.title: StockCharts Technical Rank
indicators.formula: Proprietary vendor-defined scoring system; consult current provider documentation

indicators.title: Advance Decline Line
indicators.formula: ADL(t)=ADL(t-1)+advancers-decliners

indicators.title: New 52-Week Highs Minus Lows
indicators.formula: NetHighLow=new_high_count-new_low_count

indicators.title: McClellan Oscillator
indicators.formula: Osc=EMA_fast(net_advances)-EMA_slow(net_advances)

indicators.title: Percent Above Moving Average
indicators.formula: Percent=100*count(price>MA)/eligible_universe_size

indicators.title: Put Call Volume Ratio
indicators.formula: Put/call traded-volume ratio = matching-period put options contract volume / matching-period call options contract volume; denominator must be >0.

indicators.title: Implied Volatility Index Context
indicators.formula: Index-specific calculation from qualifying option prices and strikes

indicators.title: Elder-Ray Bull and Bear Power
indicators.formula: BullPower=High-EMA(Close,13); BearPower=Low-EMA(Close,13).

indicators.title: Ease of Movement (EMV)
indicators.formula: Distance=midpoint(t)-midpoint(t-1); EMV=Distance/((Volume/declared_scale)/(High-Low)); optionally SMA(EMV,n).

indicators.title: Choppiness Index
indicators.formula: CHOP(n)=100*log10(sum(TR,n)/(HH(n)-LL(n)))/log10(n).

indicators.title: Vortex Indicator
indicators.formula: VMplus=abs(High(t)-Low(t-1)); VMminus=abs(Low(t)-High(t-1)); VIplus/minus=sum(VMplus/minus,n)/sum(TR,n).

indicators.title: Ultimate Oscillator
indicators.formula: BP=Close-min(Low,PrevClose); TR=max(High,PrevClose)-min(Low,PrevClose); UO=100*(4*BP7/TR7+2*BP14/TR14+BP28/TR28)/7.

indicators.title: True Strength Index
indicators.formula: TSI=100*EMA(EMA(Close(t)-Close(t-1),25),13)/EMA(EMA(abs(Close(t)-Close(t-1)),25),13).

indicators.title: Ulcer Index
indicators.formula: DD=100*(Close/rolling_max_close-1); UI=sqrt(mean(DD_squared over n observations)).

indicators.title: Mass Index
indicators.formula: MassIndex(n)=sum(EMA(High-Low,9)/EMA(EMA(High-Low,9),9),n); typical n=25.

indicators.title: Negative Volume Index
indicators.formula: If V(t)<V(t-1), NVI(t)=NVI(t-1)*Close(t)/Close(t-1); otherwise retain NVI.

indicators.title: Positive Volume Index
indicators.formula: If V(t)>V(t-1), PVI(t)=PVI(t-1)*Close(t)/Close(t-1); otherwise retain PVI.

indicators.title: Detrended Price Oscillator
indicators.formula: DPO at current calculation time=Close(t-shift)-SMA_N(t), shift=floor(N/2)+1; display alignment varies by platform.

indicators.title: Fisher Transform
indicators.formula: Fisher(x)=0.5*ln((1+x)/(1-x)); normalization and clamp must be specified for -1<x<1.
